sents.t: Bright two-bedroom apartment for rent on Oak Avenue.
The apartment is on the fifth floor and has a large balcony with a view of the river.
It is only a three-minute walk from Oak Avenue Station and close to several shops.
Rent is $1,400 per month, including water.
Pets are allowed, but the previous tenant's parrot learned to imitate the doorbell, so please check who is really at the door.
To arrange a viewing, call Jenny at 555-0142.
